text: {"answerable":true,"answer":"The Growth plan allows 1,200 requests per minute sustained and a burst ceiling of 2,000 requests over 60 seconds. If you exceed these limits the API returns a 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry‑After header telling you how many seconds to wait. To back off, pause your traffic until the Retry‑After period has elapsed or throttle to a rate below 1,200 RPM. Note that some endpoints have stricter per‑hour limits – for example POST /v1/exports is limited to 10 per hour, POST /v1/batch to 60 per hour (max 500 records per call), and POST /v1/auth/tokens to 30 per hour – and exceeding those also returns a 429 with an endpoint‑specific error code.","citations":["S2","S1","S3"],"confidence":0.9,"missing_information":"Whether the 429s are due to burst usage or endpoint sub‑limits cannot be confirmed from the ticket alone.","injection_suspected":false}
